About Profile inbox
Conditions
Operation in progress

How it works\nText and images are queued in system storage, even while the receiving profile is stopped. Nothing is put in its clipboard automatically. The recipient opens Profile inbox in that profile to copy an item to its clipboard or save a copy.

Privacy and encryption\nSending deliberately shares data across profiles. The queue uses device encryption, not the receiving profile\u2019s credential key, so the system can access queued data while that profile is locked. Opening or reading the inbox requires the receiving profile to be current and unlocked. Ordinary apps cannot read the queue directly. Physical erasure requires healthy writable storage and cannot guarantee removal of flash history or old journal copies.

Access and deletion\nOnly the recipient may delete a queued item. Clear inbox only clears the current profile\u2019s inbox and expiry notices. Saved and clipboard copies are kept. Disabling export stops future sends but does not retract items already delivered.

Limits\nText: 128 KiB. PNG, JPEG and WebP images: 8 MiB each. Each inbox: 32 MiB or 64 items. Device total: 128 MiB or 256 items. Full queues refuse new sends without replacing delivered items. Incomplete uploads expire after 10 minutes.

Retention\nNew items expire after 1 day, even if the receiving profile stays stopped. Exact alarms schedule cleanup. After a reboot, the system checks stored expiry times and schedules the next cleanup. Items from an earlier version keep any earlier expiry. Expired contents are deleted, expiry notice remains until the inbox is cleared. Retention across reboots assumes a reasonably correct system clock, setting it back can extend real-world retention, and setting it forward can expire items early.

Copy and Save a copy\n„Copy” and „Save a copy” keep the inbox item and do not extend its expiry. Copy uses this profile\u2019s normal clipboard and its normal lifetime, the SystemUI clipboard preview is hidden. One temporary image is kept in this profile\u2019s private SystemUI cache. Copying another image replaces it. Temporary image access expires 1 hour after „Copy” or if the inbox process restarts. Device sleep can delay cleanup, if the process stops first, the file can remain until the next inbox launch. Closing the screen does not immediately remove it.
